summary: No new runtime or dev dependencies for S2 — the entire backend stack delivered in S1 (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, Alembic, Pydantic v2, psycopg, pytest, testcontainers[postgres]) covers transaction forms, stock ledger logic, and the new migration. The 7 new ORM models, 4 new repositories, 4 new services, 3 new routers and 1 modified router fit entirely within the existing dependency footprint.

services.name: PostgreSQL 16
services.purpose: Adds 7 tables (6 transaction + 1 stock_ledger) via alembic migration 0003. Same instance as S1.

services.name: Docker (testcontainers)
services.purpose: Test execution dependency only — used by backend/tests/conftest.py for ephemeral PG. Same as S1.

env_vars.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars.description: Inherits from S1. PostgreSQL DSN. Backend cannot start without it.

env_vars.name: API_CORS_ORIGINS
env_vars.description: Inherits from S1. JSON array of allowed origins. Defaults to [] (deny by default).

env_vars.name: API_ENV
env_vars.description: Inherits from S1. Environment label. Defaults to 'development'.

frontend_deps_note: Per LLD's frontend_ui_track_note: frontend deps come via /ases-ui-scaffold S2. Likely no new npm packages beyond S1's set (react-hook-form, zod, axios, tanstack-query, shadcn/radix, sonner). Datepicker uses react-day-picker (already installed in S1 for shadcn calendar). If a numeric input component is needed beyond plain Input, that'll be added by the UI scaffold step.

carry_forward_from_s1.TD-007: Closing via DS-014 in this sprint (TimestampMixin → TIMESTAMPTZ).
carry_forward_from_s1.W5 (CF-001): PO action — does not affect S2 design. Becomes relevant for S2 /ases-test-run if W5 still open by then.
